**Compliant at the preferred position — no redline proposed.**

- **Ownership + assignment of Deliverables:** §14.2 (ownership on creation, present assignment of worldwide right/title/interest, personnel assignments, further assurance).
- **Vendor retains pre-existing IP only:** §14.3 with the definition at 1.9, which carves out Customer Data and our pre-existing IP.
- **Perpetual / irrevocable / royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor IP:** §13.2, incorporated by §14.3.
- **Customer Data:** §14.1 (we own it; only a limited processing right passes to Vendor), reinforced by §15.1's no-sale / no-advertising / no-model-training restrictions.
- **No joint ownership:** §14.4, and no aggregated-data or feedback assignment anywhere in the document.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged: §13.2 covers contractors rather than a general sublicence right, and §13.3 allows licence suspension during a material uncured breach after notice and cure — minor qualifications only.
